'''T8X-4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
T8X-4 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Imperial quest giver for the "[[Assault on Tython]]" flashpoint, though he is only found aboard Vaiken Spacedock and not on other planets like other flashpoint quest givers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
